page_title: ALA 0-0 BET | Alaves v Betis 25/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+5' Betis take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+4' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Betis win a corner.
90+2' None of the Betis players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
90+1' Betis fail to score from a corner as Antonio Sivera (Alaves) leaps to collect the ball. Betis earn a corner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' A cross by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor. Betis force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
89' Chimy Avila (Betis) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
88' That's the end of the game for Carlos Vicente, who is replaced by Moussa Diarra (Alaves).
86' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) is being sent off by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier!
86' Marc Bartra (Betis) is substituted due to injury. Manuel Pellegrini gives a chance to Natan.
85' Chance! Nabil Fekir (Betis) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
83' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
81' Corner kicks – 3:5.
79' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
77' Luis Garcia Plaza has decided to make a change. Jon Guridi (Alaves) replaces Kike Garcia.
77' The referee signals a substitution. Carlos Benavidez (Alaves) is brought on as a substitute for Ander Guevara.
77' Marc Roca (Betis) has tested the patience of referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
76' The resulting set piece from Betis is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
76' The manager makes a subsitution with Rodri (Betis) coming on for Pablo Fornals.
75' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The referee blows his whistle, Betis are awarded a corner kick.
75' Betis quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

75' Nabil Fekir (Betis) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, Antonio Sivera anticipates the shot and makes an easy save. The ball is out of play and Betis manage to earn a corner.
74' Some neat passing and movement from Betis as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
72' Betis take a short corner kick.

71' Nabil Fekir (Betis) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball. Betis force their opponents to concede a corner.
69' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
66' The Betis players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
64' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Romain Perraud (Betis) was quite harsh and Mateo Busquets Ferrer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Betis can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Manuel Pellegrini decides to make a substitution. Aitor Ruibal will be replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
63' The game has come to an end for Juanmi. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis).
62' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. Betis have been awarded a corner kick.
61' Here is a change. Stoichkov is going off and Luis Garcia Plaza gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Martin (Alaves).
61' Tomas Conechny goes off the pitch and Luka Romero (Alaves) comes on.
59' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
58' Antonio Blanco (Alaves) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
55' The game is interrupted now, Diego Llorente (Betis) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
52' A fine individual run by Nabil Fekir (Betis) culminates with a rocket of a shot from long range, but the ball fizzes just wide of the right post.
51' A corner kick by Alaves is thwarted by the well prepared Rui Silva (Betis).
51' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The ball is out of play. Alaves win a corner kick.
49' Stoichkov (Alaves) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the right post is denied by a decent save from Rui Silva.
48' Betis players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Romain Perraud (Betis) will replace Ricardo Rodriguez.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45' The corner is swung in but Alaves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
44' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Alaves have a corner.
40' Alaves hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 42:58.
36' Stoichkov (Alaves) rises high to head a nice lofted cross towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, his close-range effort lacks pace and Rui Silva makes a comfortable save.
34' William Carvalho (Betis) gathers the pass and without hesitation smashes a shot in from long range, but it goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Alaves will have a goal kick.
34' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

33' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Tomas Conechny (Alaves), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
32' Juanmi (Betis) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he skies his shot high over the bar.
29' Some great controlled play and passing from Betis. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
27' Mateo Busquets Ferrer shows a yellow card to Juanmi (Betis) for his blatant foul.
27' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
25' Betis have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
24' An attempted cross from Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) is cleared. Good work from Betis as they win a corner.
22' Alaves are seeing far more of the ball now.
18' The goal by Alaves won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
18' Attention! Referee Mateo Busquets Ferrer straight away wants to review previous situation with VAR, presumably for a possible offside in the build-up.
18' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Carlos Vicente (Alaves) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
17' Manu Sanchez (Alaves) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
15' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
13' Pablo Fornals (Betis) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
11' Juanmi (Betis) beats the defender to the lofted pass inside the box, but can't control his shot and it flashes high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Alaves.
8' A rebound falls for Ander Guevara (Alaves), who immediately lets rip with a howitzer of a shot from distance. The effort, however, is bravely blocked by a defender.
6' Tomas Conechny (Alaves) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
4' Aleksandar Sedlar (Alaves) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets Ferrer had an easy-decision to make.
4' Ander Guevara (Alaves) tries his luck with a long-range effort after receiving a precise pass, but Rui Silva has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
2' Betis are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Mateo Busquets Ferrer.
